source_message.text:
Hey Joseph, id like to eliminate the big blocks and give that extra $1 to me, so it'll be:
$15 buy, $5 to me,  $5 to affiliate,  $5 to block prize pool.

Increases my bottom line with minimal impact on sales.

Giveing myself and each community member an even split, as well as everyone getting an even shot at the never ending $500 prizes seems aligned with the projects ethos.
